PlayerProgress.title: PlayerProgress
PlayerProgress.description: Stores a player's roguelike sanctuary progression, unlocked stage level, high score, and accumulated solar coins.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the player.

displayName.description: Display name of the Solar Warden.

bestScore.description: Highest score achieved across all runs.

totalCoins.description: Current Solar Coins balance carried by the player.

runsPlayed.description: Total number of dungeon runs completed or attempted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public Global Sanctum Leaderboard record for a player, tracking high score, furthest stage, fastest speedrun time, daily challenge score, and boss rush depth.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the player.

displayName.description: Public display name of the Solar Warden (no PII).

highestStage.description: Furthest stage reached or cleared (1 to 10).

fastestClearTimeSec.description: Fastest stage clear time in seconds (1 to 86400).

dailyScore.description: Best score achieved on the recorded daily challenge seed.

bossRushWaves.description: Highest number of Boss Rush / Endless Abyss waves cleared.

bossRushScore.description: Highest score achieved in Boss Rush / Endless Abyss mode.

favoriteStance.description: Primary weapon stance used by the player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the leaderboard entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the leaderboard entry was last updated.

/playerProgress/{userId}.description: Per-user progression document keyed by the authenticated user's UID.

/leaderboardEntries/{userId}.description: Public leaderboard record keyed by the authenticated user's UID.
